report.validation: Unseen phase samples inside three trained shape families; no claim of novel shape understanding.

graph.selection: Traced vnc_* annotations. Top 128 motors by total incoming count; top 640 other VNC cells by outgoing count to these motors; top 256 sensory cells by outgoing count to those interneurons. Ties follow sorted bodyId. Keep every measured edge between selected IDs.
graph.scope: Selected motor subcircuit, not the whole fly brain. Approximate rate dynamics and engineered input/output mappings.

report.model: 4-step rate network; immutable measured adjacency; trainable positive edge gains, biases and leaks; frozen random sensory and motor interfaces.
report.inputs: 3-way task code + 6 sine/cosine clock harmonics + constant. No coordinates/waypoints/teacher at inference.
report.output: Two learned normalized pen coordinates. Stylus grasp and leg IK are engineered visual mappings; no muscle/contact/biological learning claim.
